Copied: Interfaces/ (whole), Libs/AAXLibrary/source/ (minus the Windows-only AAX_CAutoreleasePool.Win.cpp),
Libs/AAXLibrary/include/, LICENSE.txt.
Not copied: examples, docs, TI, Utilities, build projects. plugin/build.sh compiles AAXLibrary from these
sources (the SDK ships no prebuilt library).
Never edit these files; upgrade by replacing the folder.
